tasks.prompt: Create a top-level board named EVAL_T03_Card, 320 by 200 px, with a vertical flex layout and a 16 px gap between children. Put two rectangles inside it, named EVAL_T03_A and EVAL_T03_B, in that order. Place the board where it does not overlap any existing board.

verify.code: const page = penpot.currentPage; const b = penpotUtils.findShapes(s => s.name === 'EVAL_T03_Card', page.root)[0]; if (!b) return { pass: false, detail: 'missing board' }; const lay = penpotUtils.shapeStructure(b, 1).layout || {}; const names = (b.children || []).map(c => c.name); const ok = b.width === 320 && b.height === 200 && lay.type === 'flex' && lay.dir === 'column' && Number(lay.rowGap) === 16 && names.join(',') === 'EVAL_T03_A,EVAL_T03_B'; return { pass: ok, detail: { w: b.width, h: b.height, layout: lay, children: names } };

tasks.prompt: In EVAL_FIX_Board, replace every #FF0000 fill with #00AA55. Do not change anything else.

verify.code: const page = penpot.currentPage; const b = penpotUtils.findShapes(s => s.name === 'EVAL_FIX_Board', page.root)[0]; if (!b) return { pass: false, detail: 'missing board' }; const all = penpotUtils.findShapes(() => true, b); const has = (s, c) => (s.fills || []).some(f => (f.fillColor || '').toUpperCase() === c); const red = all.filter(s => has(s, '#FF0000')).length; const green = all.filter(s => has(s, '#00AA55')).length; return { pass: red === 0 && green >= 3, detail: { red, green } };

tasks.prompt: Create a new 375 by 812 board named EVAL_T06 next to the existing top-level boards. It must not overlap any of them.

verify.code: const page = penpot.currentPage; const me = penpotUtils.findShapes(s => s.name === 'EVAL_T06', page.root)[0]; if (!me) return { pass: false, detail: 'missing' }; const top = page.root.children.filter(c => c.type === 'board' && c.id !== me.id); const hit = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.width && b.x < a.x + a.width && a.y < b.y + b.height && b.y < a.y + a.height; const overlaps = top.filter(b => hit(me, b)).map(b => b.name); return { pass: me.width === 375 && me.height === 812 && overlaps.length === 0, detail: { size: [me.width, me.height], overlaps } };
